name: Volcor
summary: Volcor lies wounded in Blackwood Den, deep in southern Darkshore. The night elf scout depends on his bear Grimclaw and Auberdine's defenders to escape the hostile furbolgs.

sections.title: Trapped in the Den
sections.body: Volcor is a night elf scout wounded inside Blackwood Den. While tracking the corrupted Blackwood tribe through its underground lair, he was ambushed and badly hurt. He could not fight past the hostile furbolgs alone, so he sent Grimclaw, his loyal bear companion, into the wilds of Darkshore to seek help in Auberdine.

sections.title: A Way to Freedom
sections.body: Volcor offers his rescuer two ways out of the den, guided by their strengths. After scouts reach him with word from Terenthis, those who favor direct action can fight through the cave's defenders. Those skilled at subterfuge can instead move quietly past the sentries.

faq.answer: Volcor is hidden deep inside Blackwood Den in southern Darkshore, near the Ashenvale border and not far from the road south of Auberdine.

faq.q: Why is Volcor trapped in Blackwood Den?
aliases: why is volcor in a cave
faq.answer: Volcor was scouting the Blackwood furbolgs when they attacked and wounded him. Cut off from the cave entrance, he could not get past the hostile sentries without help.
Grimclaw is Volcor's loyal bear companion. When Volcor was trapped, he sent Grimclaw to find help in Auberdine, alerting the druid Terenthis.

faq.q: How can you help Volcor escape?
faq.answer: Volcor lets you choose how to rescue him. You can fight through the cave's furbolg guards or use stealth to slip past them.

faq.q: Who sent you to find Volcor?
faq.answer: Terenthis, a night elf druid in Auberdine, sends you to find Volcor after Grimclaw is found wandering without his master.

faq.q: What tribe of furbolgs attacked him?
faq.answer: The Blackwood tribe attacked Volcor. These furbolgs are native to Darkshore and have fallen to corruption, madness, and hostility.

angles.text: As a Night Elf, you can see the danger facing the Kaldorei in Darkshore as once-peaceful furbolg allies fall to corruption.
As a Druid, you know the bond between Volcor and Grimclaw reflects the connection druids share with nature's beasts. Their rescue touches the balance of nature.
As a Rogue, you can use tactical finesse to slip quietly past the Blackwood guards instead of relying on brute force.
